headlines.title: 한·일 재계 “ 신산업 공동개척해 ‘ 새로운 60년’ 만들자”
headlines.summary: 한경협-日게이단렌 회의 韓 CPTPP 가입 등 협력 한·일 경제계가 신시장·신산업을 공동 개척해 ‘새로운 60년’을 만들자는 데 뜻을 모았다. 글로벌 공급망 불안 등 공통 과제에 함께 대응하고, 양국 산업 역량을 결합해 글로벌 시장과 지역경제에서 새로운 성장 기회를 창출하자는 구상이다.

headlines.title: “ 환율 하락 장기화되면 내년 성장률 하방압력”
headlines.summary: 비반도체 업종이 특히 민감 최근 원·달러 환율의 가파른 하락세가 수출기업에 새로운 부담 요인으로 떠오르고 있다. 원화 강세에 따른 수출 충격은 시차를 두고 확대될 수 있어 비반도체 업종을 중심으로 수출 증가세가 둔화하고, 내년 경제성장률에도 하방 압력으로 작용할 수 있다는 지적이 제기된다.

key_headlines.title: Government to Triple Physical AI Budget to 3.1 Trillion Won
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's government plans to increase physical AI investment threefold to 3.1 trillion won next year, integrating AI into manufacturing and robotics as a post-semiconductor growth engine. The initiative aims to establish Korea as a leader in the AI era.

key_headlines.title: Won Strengthens as Currency Falls, Threatens Non-Semiconductor Export Growth
key_headlines.summary: Prolonged won strengthening against the dollar is creating new burdens for exporters, with non-semiconductor sectors particularly vulnerable to slowing export growth that could pressure economic expansion next year.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea Holds Base Rate at 3.00% Unanimously
key_headlines.summary: The Bank of Korea's monetary policy committee unanimously maintained the base rate at 3.00% to assess effects of previous rate hikes, while inflation remains above the 2% target at 2.9%.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Rentals Shift to Monthly Leases; 60% of New Contracts Are Monthly Rent
key_headlines.summary: In Seoul's second quarter, 58% of new apartment rental transactions were monthly rentals compared to jeonse (long-term deposits), with average converted monthly rent reaching 3.17 million won, up 13.5% year-over-year.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI and KOSDAQ Drop 3% on US Tech Stock Decline and AI Concerns
key_headlines.summary: South Korean stock markets fell sharply as overnight US technology stock selloffs and AI sector uncertainties spread, with semiconductor majors like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix leading declines.

sections.Hot Economy News: The South Korean government is positioning itself as an AI leader by tripling physical AI budget allocation to 3.1 trillion won and embedding AI technology across seven major SEED projects including biotech and small modular reactors. Officials emphasized manufacturing and robotics as the post-semiconductor growth frontier. However, currency headwinds are emerging as the strengthening won threatens export competitiveness, particularly for non-semiconductor sectors. AI education budget reaches 2.1 trillion won as part of broader digital economy initiatives discussed at a government forum.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song projected next year's inflation will exceed the previous forecast of 2.5% and signaled higher growth prospects for both current and next year, with new forecasts coming after the November monetary policy meeting. The central bank maintained the base rate at 3.00% in a unanimous decision, prioritizing assessment of previous consecutive rate hikes from July and August. Current inflation remains elevated at 2.9%, above the 2% target, requiring calibrated monetary policy responses. The government faces policy coordination challenges between promoting housing supply and maintaining financial constraints on real estate lending.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korean stock markets opened sharply lower on October 23, with KOSPI and KOSDAQ both declining over 3% in response to overnight US technology stock selloffs and AI sector concerns. Foreign investors engaged in substantial selling, with semiconductor giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix among the hardest hit. SK Hynix announced suspension of its subsidiary Solidigm's IPO plans due to changed market conditions, despite maintaining confidence in the company's growth potential. The market faces headwinds from US FOMC decisions and major tech earnings announcements expected this week.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea is advancing electric vehicle domestic production tax credits modeled after Japan's approach, with proposed policies linking incentives to production volumes and supporting battery supply chain investments. Battery maker EcoPro focused on securing market leadership in high-energy-density batteries for expanding electric vehicle and AI robotics sectors. Intel secured US FCC exemption allowing continued use of foreign-made automation equipment to prevent semiconductor production disruptions. The government is simultaneously pushing AI data center regulations and investing 200 billion won in homegrown semiconductor equipment development.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment rental markets show dramatic shift toward monthly leases, with 58% of second-quarter new contracts being monthly rentals compared to traditional jeonse deposits. Average converted monthly rent for 60-85 square meter apartments reached 3.17 million won, representing 13.5% year-over-year growth, placing significant burden on renters. Small apartments under 60 square meters account for two-thirds of monthly lease transactions, indicating structural market changes. Outside Seoul, emerging residential complexes with comprehensive living infrastructure are attracting substantial buyer and subscription interest.
sections.International Economy: Global investment capital is shifting toward safe-haven assets, particularly US Treasury bonds, as US technology stocks decline and AI sector uncertainties persist amid Middle East geopolitical tensions and European concerns. The US dollar weakened overnight with 10-year Treasury yields dipping below 5% for the first time since late September, marking the largest single-day decline since March 2023. Next week's US Federal Reserve FOMC meeting is expected to maintain rates while signaling future policy direction amid persistent inflation pressures. Oil prices reached 5-month highs as Middle East tensions drive energy market volatility.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea's government dramatically increased AI investment focus, allocating substantial budgets to data center infrastructure and domestic semiconductor equipment production, with simplified permitting processes for AI data center construction. SK Hynix suspended Solidigm IPO plans not due to confidence issues but market conditions, while maintaining commitment to US production capacity expansion to meet growing AI memory demand. Private sector investments in AI are increasingly scrutinized for profitability and cost effectiveness as market expectations rise. Korea-Japan economic cooperation expanded discussion of AI and new market development alongside CPTPP and energy collaboration.
sections.Others: Korea Western Power received global recognition for innovative HR development practices at Paris's UNLEASH Award, demonstrating how employee growth drives company competitiveness in the energy transition era. Budget office disputes emerged regarding future response fund legislation and inter-agency coordination processes, with commitment to enhanced parliamentary-level discussions. Celltrion's Omniclaro gained competitive advantage in the US omalizumab biosimilar market as rival products face FDA delays and patent litigation from originators Genentech and Novartis. Fifth national railway network plan remains on track for year-end announcement despite inter-agency budget coordination challenges.
